cohort: The study included 100 pregnant women, 50 presenting with preterm labour (28-37 weeks gestation) and 50 with complication-free pregnancies, at Al-Yarmouk Teaching Hospital.
finding: Maternal serum amyloid A level in the 2nd trimester was significantly higher in women with preterm labour and may serve as a predictive marker for this condition.
cross-section timing: Serum samples were taken from subjects at admission before any intervention.
